en: Not present at a place or event.
toeic: Two directors were absent from the annual general meeting.
toeic_zh: 有兩位董事缺席年度股東會。

en: in a way that suits the situation
toeic: Prices will be adjusted accordingly after the new tax takes effect.
toeic_zh: 新稅制生效後，價格將會相應調整。

en: also; used to add more information
toeic: Additionally, all participants will receive a free gift.
toeic_zh: 此外，所有參加者都會收到一份免費贈品。

en: at a later time
simple: We ate and went home afterward.
simple_zh: 我們吃完飯後就回家了。
toeic: Please submit the form, and we will call you afterward.
toeic_zh: 請提交表格，我們之後會致電給您。

en: an official representing a country or brand
toeic: She was named brand ambassador for our new product line.
toeic_zh: 她被任命為我們新產品系列的品牌代言人。

en: again in a new way
toeic: After the merger, the team had to begin anew.
toeic_zh: 合併後，團隊必須重新開始。

en: in any case; anyway
simple: It rained, but we went anyhow.
simple_zh: 下雨了，但我們還是去了。
toeic: The meeting may run late, but we will finish anyhow.
toeic_zh: 會議可能會延遲，但無論如何我們都會完成。

en: relevant or suitable; can be applied
simple: Applicable rules are enforced during meetings.
simple_zh: 在會議期間執行了適用的規則。
toeic: Applicable standards ensure consistent quality.
toeic_zh: 適用的標準確保了一致的質量。

en: one part or feature of something
simple: This is a good aspect of the job.
simple_zh: 這是這份工作好的一面。
toeic: We reviewed every aspect of the new project plan.
toeic_zh: 我們檢視了新專案計畫的每個層面。

en: a task or piece of work allocated to someone
simple: The assignment requires completing a detailed report.
simple_zh: 這項任務要求完成詳細報告。
toeic: Team members received their assignments at the beginning of the project.
toeic_zh: 團隊成員在項目開始時收到了他們的任務分配。

en: a person who provides a service to others
simple: The attendant will help check everyone in.
simple_zh: 服務員將幫助所有人簽到。
toeic: Flight attendants will assist passengers during the conference trip.
toeic_zh: 空乘人員將在會議旅行期間協助乘客。

en: a person who is present at an event
simple: Every attendee must sign the attendance sheet.
simple_zh: 每位參加者都必須簽到。
toeic: The attendees received a welcome package upon arrival.
toeic_zh: 參加者在到達時收到歡迎禮包。

en: a large room for dances and events
toeic: The annual dinner will be held in the hotel ballroom.
toeic_zh: 年度晚宴將在飯店宴會廳舉行。

en: a large formal meal for many people
simple: We went to a wedding banquet.
toeic: The company will host a banquet for retiring employees.
toeic_zh: 公司將為退休員工舉辦一場宴會。

en: earlier than a particular time
toeic: Please let us know beforehand if you need a special meal.
toeic_zh: 如果您需要特殊餐點，請事先告知我們。

en: favorable or promoting wellbeing
simple_zh: 會議後實施了有益的變更。
toeic: Beneficial partnerships enhance business growth.
toeic_zh: 有益的伙伴關係促進了業務增長。

en: A room where company directors hold meetings.
simple: The boss is in the boardroom.
simple_zh: 老闆在董事會會議室裡。
toeic: The quarterly review will take place in the boardroom at ten.
toeic_zh: 季度檢討將於十點在董事會會議室舉行。

en: A small, thin book with a paper cover.
simple: I got a booklet at the museum.
simple_zh: 我在博物館拿到一本小冊子。
toeic: Each participant will receive a booklet with the workshop schedule.
toeic_zh: 每位參加者都會收到一本附有工作坊日程的小冊子。

en: To share many ideas quickly in a group.
simple_zh: 我們每週五腦力激盪想點子。
toeic: The team will brainstorm solutions during the afternoon workshop.
toeic_zh: 團隊將在下午的工作坊中腦力激盪尋找解決方案。

en: A meal where guests serve themselves from a table.
toeic: A buffet lunch will be provided for all conference attendees.
toeic_zh: 所有會議出席者將享用自助午餐。

en: A chart showing the days, weeks and months of a year.
simple_zh: 看一下日曆上的星期五。
toeic: Please add the meeting to the shared calendar.
toeic_zh: 請把會議加到共用行事曆上。

en: To provide food and drinks, or meet particular needs.
simple_zh: 他們承辦大型派對的餐飲。
toeic: Our company will cater the awards dinner next Friday.
toeic_zh: 我們公司將承辦下週五的頒獎晚宴餐飲。

en: A person or company that provides food for events.
simple_zh: 外燴業者把食物送來了。
toeic: We hired a caterer for the product launch event.
toeic_zh: 我們為產品發表會聘請了一家外燴業者。

en: The person who leads a meeting or committee.
toeic: The chairperson will announce the results of the vote.
toeic_zh: 主席將宣布投票結果。

en: To hit your hands together to show you like something.
toeic: The audience stood up to clap for the speaker.
toeic_zh: 觀眾起立為講者鼓掌。

en: closely packed together; occupying little space
simple: The compact meeting room fits ten people.
simple_zh: 緊湊的會議室可容納10人。
toeic: A compact schedule maximizes productivity.
toeic_zh: 緊湊的日程最大化了生產力。

en: Following one after another without a break.
simple: It rained for three consecutive days.
toeic: Sales rose for the fourth consecutive quarter.
toeic_zh: 銷售額連續第四季成長。

en: to say the opposite of or disagree with
simple: Please do not contradict your boss.
toeic: The new data seems to contradict the earlier findings.
toeic_zh: 新數據似乎與先前的研究結果相矛盾。

en: completely different or opposite
toeic: Contrary to expectations, the new product sold poorly.
toeic_zh: 與預期相反，新產品賣得不好。

en: to work together with others
toeic: All departments must cooperate to finish the project on schedule.
toeic_zh: 所有部門必須合作，才能如期完成專案。

en: a person who organizes the activities of different people
simple: The project coordinator manages all team communications.
simple_zh: 項目協調員管理所有團隊溝通。
toeic: Contact the event coordinator to arrange the meeting room.
toeic_zh: 聯繫活動協調員安排會議室。

en: clear and certain
toeic: We have not set a definite date for the product launch yet.
toeic_zh: 我們尚未確定產品上市的日期。

en: a doctor who treats teeth
toeic: I need to reschedule my appointment with the dentist.
toeic_zh: 我需要重新安排與牙醫的預約。

en: to leave a place, especially on a trip
toeic: Flight 208 will depart from Gate 12 at nine o'clock.
toeic_zh: 208 號班機將於九點從十二號登機門出發。

en: relating to one department of an organization
toeic: The departmental budget must be approved by the end of the month.
toeic_zh: 部門預算必須在月底前核准。

en: to choose someone or something for a purpose
simple: We designate one person to lead.
toeic: The manager will designate a representative to attend the conference.
toeic_zh: 經理將指派一名代表出席研討會。

en: lack of consensus or a difference of opinion
simple: There was disagreement about the sales strategy.
simple_zh: 對於銷售策略有意見不合。
toeic: The disagreement between departments delayed the project decision.
toeic_zh: 部門之間的意見不合延遲了項目決定。

en: to take attention away from something
toeic: Please silence your phone so it does not distract other attendees.
toeic_zh: 請將手機靜音，以免讓其他與會者分心。

en: something that takes your attention away
toeic: Turn off the television to avoid any distraction during the meeting.
toeic_zh: 請關掉電視，以免會議中分心。

en: the length of time that something continues
simple: The duration of the meeting is two hours.
simple_zh: 會議的持續時間是兩小時。
toeic: The project duration has been extended by three months.
toeic_zh: 項目持續時間已延長三個月。

en: a person who studies the economy
simple_zh: 那位經濟學家在電視上發言。
toeic: An economist predicts that interest rates will rise next year.
toeic_zh: 一位經濟學家預測明年利率將上升。

en: in a way that shows strong interest
toeic: The audience responded enthusiastically to the presentation.
toeic_zh: 觀眾對簡報反應熱烈。

en: to go with someone to guide or protect them
simple: A guard will escort you out.
toeic: A staff member will escort visitors to the meeting room.
toeic_zh: 一位員工會陪同訪客前往會議室。

en: clearly visible or understood
simple: It was evident that the meeting was successful.
toeic: The need for change was evident from the data.
toeic_zh: 從數據中可以看出需要變革。

en: in an official or serious way
simple: He was formally introduced to us.
toeic: The merger will be formally announced next Monday.
toeic_zh: 這次合併將於下週一正式宣布。

en: a meeting or medium for discussion of topics of interest
simple: The online forum allows participants to ask questions anytime.
simple_zh: 在線論壇允許參與者隨時提問。
toeic: Join the international forum to share best practices.
toeic_zh: 加入國際論壇以分享最佳實踐。

en: a person who starts a company or group
simple: The founder of the shop is here.
simple_zh: 這家店的創辦人在這裡。
toeic: The founder of the company will give the opening speech.
toeic_zh: 公司創辦人將發表開幕演說。

en: school work students do at home
simple: I finish my homework at night.
toeic: Do your homework on the client before attending the meeting.
toeic_zh: 在參加會議前，請先針對客戶做好功課。

en: wanting to eat food
toeic: If you are hungry, there are snacks in the meeting room.
toeic_zh: 如果您餓了，會議室裡有點心。

en: not reasonable or sensible
toeic: The manager felt the proposed schedule was illogical and too tight.
toeic_zh: 經理認為所提議的時程不合理，而且太緊。

en: including all types or categories
simple: An inclusive meeting welcomes all opinions.
simple_zh: 包容的會議歡迎所有意見。
toeic: Inclusive practices ensure diverse participation.
toeic_zh: 包容的做法確保了多樣化的參與。

en: separately, one at a time
simple_zh: 每個玩具都是個別包裝的。
toeic: The manager will meet with each team member individually.
toeic_zh: 經理將與每位團隊成員單獨會面。

en: to decide something is true from the facts
simple: I infer that he is tired.
toeic: From the report, we can infer that sales will fall next quarter.
toeic_zh: 從報告中，我們可以推斷下一季銷售額將下滑。

en: a conclusion based on facts
toeic: The inference drawn from the survey was that customers want lower prices.
toeic_zh: 從調查得出的推論是顧客想要更低的價格。

en: relaxed and not official
simple_zh: 我們進行了一次非正式談話。
toeic: The company will hold an informal gathering after the seminar.
toeic_zh: 公司將在研討會後舉辦一場非正式聚會。

en: with full attention
toeic: The audience listened intently to the CEO's speech.
toeic_zh: 聽眾專注地聆聽執行長的演說。

en: a person who translates speech into another language
toeic: The company hired an interpreter for the meeting with the Japanese clients.
toeic_zh: 公司為與日本客戶的會議聘請了一位口譯員。

en: to stop someone while they are speaking or working
toeic: Sorry to interrupt, but your client is waiting on line two.
toeic_zh: 抱歉打斷一下，您的客戶正在二線等候。

en: not connected to the subject
toeic: Please remove any irrelevant details from your report.
toeic_zh: 請刪除報告中任何無關的細節。

en: A person who gives talks or teaches at a university
toeic: The guest lecturer will talk about marketing trends.
toeic_zh: 客座講師將談論行銷趨勢。

en: Very long, often too long
simple: The meeting was lengthy and boring.
toeic: Please avoid lengthy explanations in your report.
toeic_zh: 請避免在報告中使用冗長的說明。

en: capable of reasoning correctly
simple: The logical flow of the presentation was easy to follow.
simple_zh: 演示的邏輯流程很容易跟進。
toeic: A logical conclusion was reached after careful analysis.
toeic_zh: 經過仔細分析後得出了合理的結論。

en: A formal lunch event
simple: We will attend a luncheon on Friday.
simple_zh: 我們星期五要參加一場午宴。
toeic: The annual awards luncheon will be held at the Grand Hotel.
toeic_zh: 年度頒獎午宴將在大飯店舉行。

en: The time between two events
simple: In the meantime, please take a seat.
toeic: The new system arrives next week; in the meantime, use the old one.
toeic_zh: 新系統下週到貨；在此期間請使用舊系統。

en: Twelve o'clock in the daytime
toeic: The meeting will begin promptly at noon.
toeic_zh: 會議將在正午準時開始。

en: Used to say the exact hour
simple: The class starts at nine o'clock.
toeic: The shuttle bus leaves the hotel at eight o'clock.
toeic_zh: 接駁巴士八點從旅館出發。

en: In a formal and approved way
toeic: The new policy will officially take effect on July 1.
toeic_zh: 新政策將於7月1日正式生效。

en: continuing to develop or happen
simple: Ongoing discussions will continue after the meeting.
toeic: Ongoing projects require regular status update meetings.
toeic_zh: 進行中的項目需要定期狀態更新會議。

en: A large group of musicians
toeic: The city orchestra will perform at the grand opening.
toeic_zh: 市立管弦樂團將在開幕典禮上演出。

en: a person who arranges and plans an event or activity
simple: The organizer prepared everything for the conference.
simple_zh: 組織者為會議準備了一切。
toeic: Contact the event organizer for any questions about registration.
toeic_zh: 有任何關於註冊的問題，請聯繫活動組織者。

en: what is expected to happen in the future
toeic: The economic outlook for next year is positive.
toeic_zh: 明年的經濟前景樂觀。

en: a short general description of something
simple: Here is an overview of the plan.
toeic: The presentation begins with an overview of our sales results.
toeic_zh: 簡報一開始先概述我們的銷售成果。

en: a block of paper for writing notes
simple: I need a pad and a pen.
simple_zh: 我需要一本便條本和一支筆。
toeic: Please leave a notepad and pad of paper on each desk.
toeic_zh: 請在每張桌上放一本便條本。

en: a person who entertains an audience
toeic: Each performer will have thirty minutes on the main stage.
toeic_zh: 每位表演者在主舞台有三十分鐘。

en: a person or book that organizes plans
simple: I write it in my planner.
simple_zh: 我把它寫在我的行事曆上。
toeic: The event planner booked the hall for the conference.
toeic_zh: 活動企劃人員為研討會預訂了會場。

en: to come before something
toeic: A short speech will precede the awards ceremony.
toeic_zh: 頒獎典禮之前會有一段簡短致詞。

en: coming before the main part
toeic: The preliminary results will be announced on Friday.
toeic_zh: 初步結果將於週五公布。

en: a person who presents or introduces a show or program
simple: The presenter explained the new product features clearly.
simple_zh: 主講人清楚地解釋了新產品的功能。
toeic: Our top presenter will lead tomorrow's training session.
toeic_zh: 我們的頂級主講人將主持明天的培訓課程。

en: likely to happen or be true
toeic: It is probable that the shipment will arrive late.
toeic_zh: 貨物很可能會延遲抵達。

en: producing much fruit or vegetation; creative
simple: The meeting was very productive and informative.
simple_zh: 會議非常有成效且內容豐富。
toeic: Productive discussions led to actionable solutions.
toeic_zh: 富有成效的討論導致了可行的解決方案。

en: quickly or exactly on time
toeic: The meeting will start promptly at nine o'clock.
toeic_zh: 會議將於九點整準時開始。

en: arriving or doing something at the expected time
simple: Punctual arrival is expected at all meetings.
simple_zh: 所有會議都期望守時到達。
toeic: Punctual presentation of reports is required.
toeic_zh: 需要準時提交報告。

en: sensible and based on what is possible
toeic: We need to set a realistic deadline for the project.
toeic_zh: 我們需要為這個專案訂定切合實際的期限。

en: to change the order or position of things
toeic: We had to rearrange the meeting because the manager was ill.
toeic_zh: 由於經理生病，我們必須重新安排會議。

en: to think again about a decision
toeic: We urge the board to reconsider the proposed budget cuts.
toeic_zh: 我們敦促董事會重新考慮擬議的預算削減。

en: food and drink served at an event
simple: We had refreshment after the show.
simple_zh: 表演後我們享用了茶點。
toeic: Light refreshment will be served after the presentation.
toeic_zh: 簡報結束後將提供簡單的茶點。

en: a practice before a performance or event
toeic: The final rehearsal for the awards ceremony is on Thursday.
toeic_zh: 頒獎典禮的最後彩排在週四。

en: to practice before a performance
toeic: You should rehearse your speech before the big meeting.
toeic_zh: 你應該在大型會議前預演你的演講。

en: to arrange something for a different time
simple: Can we reschedule the meeting to next Monday?
simple_zh: 我們能把會議改期到下週一嗎？
toeic: The client requested to reschedule the presentation due to prior commitments.
toeic_zh: 由於先前的承諾，客戶要求重新安排演示。

en: a quiet place or trip away from work
simple_zh: 我們去參加了靜修活動。
toeic: The company holds an annual retreat for its senior managers.
toeic_zh: 公司每年為資深經理舉辦一次研修營。

en: a meeting of people after a long time
toeic: The class reunion will be held at a hotel downtown.
toeic_zh: 同學會將在市中心的一家飯店舉行。

en: a change made to improve a text or plan
simple: I made one revision to the letter.
simple_zh: 我對這封信做了一處修改。
toeic: Please send the final revision of the contract by Friday.
toeic_zh: 請在週五前寄出合約的最終修訂版。

en: two slices of bread with food between
simple: I eat a sandwich for lunch.
toeic: The caterer will deliver sandwiches to the meeting room at noon.
toeic_zh: 外燴業者中午會把三明治送到會議室。

en: a meeting for discussion or training on a particular topic
simple: The HR department organized a seminar on workplace safety.
simple_zh: 人力資源部組織了一場關於工作場所安全的研討班。
toeic: Employees attended a professional development seminar last week.
toeic_zh: 員工上週參加了專業發展研討班。

en: To make something shorter in time or length.
toeic: We need to shorten the meeting to thirty minutes.
toeic_zh: 我們需要把會議縮短為三十分鐘。

en: in a very short time
toeic: Our manager will join the meeting shortly.
toeic_zh: 我們經理很快就會加入會議。

en: to read quickly without careful attention
simple: I skim the news every morning.
toeic: Please skim the report before the meeting begins.
toeic_zh: 請在會議開始前先瀏覽這份報告。

en: a narrow opening or a time period
simple: Put the card in the slot.
toeic: We have an open time slot on Tuesday afternoon.
toeic_zh: 我們週二下午有一個空檔時段。

en: at an unknown time in the future
simple: I want to visit Japan someday.
toeic: We hope to open a branch in Paris someday.
toeic_zh: 我們希望有一天能在巴黎開一家分公司。

en: at a time that is not known or fixed
toeic: The manager will visit our office sometime next month.
toeic_zh: 經理下個月某個時候會來我們辦公室。

en: an action or strategy carefully planned to achieve an end
simple: The sales team used different tactics to close deals.
simple_zh: 銷售團隊使用不同的戰術來成交。
toeic: Negotiation tactics were discussed in the training session.
toeic_zh: 談判戰術在培訓課程中進行了討論。

en: done in a careful and complete manner
simple: Thorough review of proposals is required.
simple_zh: 需要對提案進行徹底審查。
toeic: Thorough preparation ensures meeting success.
toeic_zh: 周密的準備確保會議成功。

en: occurring at or done at an opportune or useful moment
simple: Timely information delivery is essential for good decisions.
simple_zh: 及時的信息傳遞對做出好決定至關重要。
toeic: Timely notification of changes prevents confusion.
toeic_zh: 及時通知變更可防止混亂。

en: a list of times when things happen
toeic: The timetable shows that the next train leaves at noon.
toeic_zh: 時刻表顯示下一班火車中午發車。

en: Not able to be used, bought, or met.
toeic: The item you requested is currently unavailable in our warehouse.
toeic_zh: 您訂購的商品目前倉庫缺貨。

en: To draw a line under words.
toeic: Underline the key figures in the report before the meeting.
toeic_zh: 開會前請在報告中的關鍵數字下劃線。

en: Not real; hard to believe.
toeic: The sales forecast seems unreal given current market conditions.
toeic_zh: 以目前的市場狀況來看，這個銷售預測似乎不切實際。

en: Going to happen soon.
toeic: Please review the agenda for the upcoming board meeting.
toeic_zh: 請檢視即將舉行的董事會議議程。

en: A meeting held by video over the internet.
simple: We have a videoconference at ten.
toeic: The team will join the videoconference from three different cities.
toeic_zh: 團隊成員將從三個不同城市加入視訊會議。

en: Any day from Monday to Friday.
toeic: The library is open from nine to six on every weekday.
toeic_zh: 圖書館平日每天九點到六點開放。

en: Any person who.
simple: Whoever comes first gets a seat.
toeic: Whoever finishes the report first should send it to the manager.
toeic_zh: 無論誰先完成報告，都應寄給經理。

en: a meeting at which a group of people engages in intensive discussion or training
simple: The software workshop teaches advanced coding techniques.
simple_zh: 軟件工作坊教授高級編碼技術。
toeic: Our company hosts quarterly workshops for skills development.
toeic_zh: 我們的公司每季度舉辦技能發展工作坊。

en: Good enough to deserve the time or money spent.
toeic: Attending the trade show proved worthwhile for our sales team.
toeic_zh: 參加貿易展對我們的業務團隊來說很值得。

en: Happening once every year.
toeic: Our yearly sales meeting will be held in Tokyo this time.
toeic_zh: 我們的年度業務會議這次將在東京舉行。

en: relating to all the members of a group together
simple: Collective decisions were made through voting.
simple_zh: 通過投票做出了集體決定。
toeic: The collective input shaped the final strategy.
toeic_zh: 集體意見塑造了最終戰略。

en: general agreement among group members
simple: We reached a consensus on the project timeline.
simple_zh: 我們就項目時間表達成了共識。
toeic: The team worked to build consensus before implementing changes.
toeic_zh: 團隊在實施變更前努力建立共識。

en: prolonged public disagreement or heated debate
simple: The controversy over the new policy divided the team.
simple_zh: 關於新政策的爭議分裂了團隊。
toeic: The project faced controversy regarding its environmental impact.
toeic_zh: 該項目因其環境影響而面臨爭議。

en: relating to cooperation between parties
simple: Cooperative participants made the meeting run smoothly.
simple_zh: 樂於配合的參與者使會議順利進行。
toeic: A cooperative spirit is essential for project success.
toeic_zh: 合作精神對項目成功至關重要。

en: To delay something until a later time.
simple: Let's defer the decision until Monday.
simple_zh: 我們把決定延到週一吧。
toeic: The committee decided to defer the vote until the next meeting.
toeic_zh: 委員會決定把表決延到下次會議。

en: not supporting either side in a conflict
simple: A neutral position is maintained during disputes.
simple_zh: 在爭議中保持中立立場。
toeic: Neutral ground provides a safe space for negotiations.
toeic_zh: 中立的地點為談判提供了安全的空間。

en: an expression of disagreement or disapproval
simple: No objections were raised during the meeting.
toeic: The manager addressed the team's objections to the new policy.
toeic_zh: 經理解決了團隊對新政策的異議。

en: To cover part of the same time or area.
toeic: The sales meeting may overlap with the training session.
toeic_zh: 業務會議可能與培訓課程時間重疊。

en: based on reason or logic
simple: A rational decision was made after considering all options.
simple_zh: 在考慮所有選項後做出了合理的決定。
toeic: The rational basis for the decision was explained clearly.
toeic_zh: 決定的理性基礎得到了明確解釋。

en: lower in rank or position
simple: Subordinate staff attended the department meeting.
simple_zh: 下屬人員參加了部門會議。
toeic: Subordinate details were handled by the committee.
toeic_zh: 委員會處理了從屬細節。

en: a meeting of heads of state or senior officials
simple: The international summit brought together world leaders.
simple_zh: 國際峰會聚集了世界領導人。
toeic: The annual business summit showcases innovation and industry trends.
toeic_zh: 年度商業峰會展示創新和行業趨勢。

en: done in a methodical and organized way
simple: A systematic approach prevents overlooking important topics.
simple_zh: 系統的方法可以防止遺漏重要主題。
toeic: Systematic review of all proposals was completed.
toeic_zh: 對所有提案的系統審查已完成。

en: open and clear, easy to perceive or understand
simple: Transparent communication builds trust in meetings.
simple_zh: 透明的溝通在會議中建立信任。
toeic: The company maintains transparent reporting to stakeholders.
toeic_zh: 公司對利益相關者保持透明報告。

en: not physically existing but made to appear by software
simple: Virtual meetings save travel time and costs.
simple_zh: 虛擬會議節省旅行時間和成本。
toeic: The company held a virtual conference with 5,000 participants.
toeic_zh: 公司舉行了一次有5000名參與者的虛擬會議。

en: A large public meeting to support a cause.
toeic: The sales rally boosted team morale before the product launch.
toeic_zh: 在產品上市前，業務大會提振了團隊士氣。

en: Ready to face danger or difficulty.
toeic: It was brave of her to speak up during the meeting.
toeic_zh: 她在會議中勇敢發言，真有膽量。

en: the chance that something will happen
toeic: The odds of winning this contract are quite high.
toeic_zh: 贏得這份合約的機率相當高。

en: spoken, not written
toeic: An oral agreement is not enough; please sign the contract.
toeic_zh: 口頭協議是不夠的，請簽署合約。

en: a group joining together for a goal
toeic: A coalition of retailers asked for new trade rules.
toeic_zh: 一個零售商聯盟要求制定新的貿易規則。

en: having a sharp, unpleasant taste or feeling
toeic: The negotiations ended in bitter disagreement.
toeic_zh: 談判在激烈的爭執中結束。

en: belonging to each person separately
simple: They went to their respective rooms.
simple_zh: 他們各自回到自己的房間。
toeic: Team members will present their respective reports on Friday.
toeic_zh: 團隊成員將在週五報告各自的報告。

en: a possible situation or series of events
toeic: In the worst-case scenario, we would delay the launch.
toeic_zh: 在最糟的情況下，我們會延後上市。

en: relating to a colony or its ruling country
simple: The hotel is a colonial building.
simple_zh: 這家飯店是殖民時期建築。
toeic: Our colonial style inn attracts many tourists.
toeic_zh: 我們的殖民風格旅店吸引許多觀光客。

en: at the same time
toeic: Both lines can run simultaneously without slowing down.
toeic_zh: 兩條生產線可以同時運作而不會變慢。

en: a book where you write daily events
simple: I write in my diary every night.
toeic: She wrote the meeting time in her diary.
toeic_zh: 她把會議時間記在她的記事簿裡。

en: very impressive and exciting to see
toeic: The resort offers spectacular views of the ocean.
toeic_zh: 這座度假村可欣賞壯觀的海景。

en: a position or opinion on an issue
simple: What is your stance on this?
simple_zh: 你對這件事的立場是什麼？
toeic: The firm took a firm stance against late payments.
toeic_zh: 公司對延遲付款採取強硬立場。

en: a sound heard again after it hits a surface
simple: I heard an echo in the hall.
toeic: The large meeting room has an echo that makes it hard to hear.
toeic_zh: 這間大會議室有回音，讓人很難聽清楚。

en: in spite of that; however
simple: It rained; nonetheless, we went out.
simple_zh: 下雨了，儘管如此我們還是出門了。
toeic: The price is high; nonetheless, the product sells well.
toeic_zh: 價格雖高，但這項產品仍然賣得很好。

en: used to introduce more exact details
simple: I like two fruits, namely apples and pears.
simple_zh: 我喜歡兩種水果，即蘋果和梨子。
toeic: We need two things, namely a budget and a schedule.
toeic_zh: 我們需要兩樣東西，也就是預算和時程表。

en: to run or go somewhere very quickly
simple: I must dash to the station.
toeic: We had to dash to the airport to catch our flight.
toeic_zh: 我們得趕緊衝去機場搭乘班機。

en: great size or importance
simple: The magnitude of the problem is big.
simple_zh: 這個問題的嚴重程度很大。
toeic: Managers underestimated the magnitude of the budget shortfall.
toeic_zh: 經理們低估了預算短缺的嚴重程度。

en: not sure or not decided
simple: I am uncertain about the date.
toeic: The economic outlook remains uncertain for exporters.
toeic_zh: 對出口商而言，經濟前景依然不明朗。

en: a fight or strong disagreement; a conflict
simple: There was a clash of ideas.
toeic: A schedule clash forced us to move the meeting.
toeic_zh: 行程衝突讓我們必須更改會議時間。

en: related to the plans used to reach a goal
toeic: The team made a tactical decision to delay the product launch.
toeic_zh: 團隊做出了延後產品上市的策略性決定。

en: in a way related to people and society
toeic: The firm wants to be socially responsible in all its operations.
toeic_zh: 該公司希望在所有營運中善盡社會責任。

en: the act of joining together; a joining word
toeic: The event was held in conjunction with the trade fair.
toeic_zh: 這項活動與商展同時舉辦。

en: the chance that something will happen
simple: There is a high likelihood of rain.
toeic: There is a strong likelihood that prices will rise next quarter.
toeic_zh: 下一季物價很可能會上漲。

en: a person who watches or notices things
toeic: Industry observers expect the merger to be approved soon.
toeic_zh: 業界觀察人士預期這項合併很快會獲批准。

en: power or influence to get a result
simple_zh: 我們的規模給了我們影響力。
toeic: The firm used its market leverage to negotiate better prices.
toeic_zh: 該公司運用其市場影響力談到更好的價格。

en: Coming one after another
toeic: The company reported profits for five successive quarters.
toeic_zh: 公司連續五季獲利。

en: Completely or openly
toeic: The board rejected the proposal outright.
toeic_zh: 董事會當場完全否決了該提案。

en: In a general way; widely
toeic: Broadly speaking, sales have improved since the launch.
toeic_zh: 大致來說，產品上市後銷售已有改善。

en: The state of being completely sure
toeic: There is no certainty that the deal will be approved.
toeic_zh: 無法確定這筆交易會獲得批准。

en: Together as a group
toeic: The directors collectively approved the merger.
toeic_zh: 董事們共同批准了這項合併。

en: Done on purpose or carefully planned
toeic: The delay was a deliberate move to avoid extra costs.
toeic_zh: 延後是為了避免額外成本而刻意採取的舉動。

en: To move slowly without control
toeic: Sales began to drift downward during the summer.
toeic_zh: 夏季期間銷售開始逐漸下滑。

en: To face a problem or person directly
simple_zh: 我們必須面對這個問題。
toeic: The manager decided to confront the issue at the next meeting.
toeic_zh: 經理決定在下次會議中正面處理這個問題。

en: Not connected to something
toeic: Please keep your comments unrelated to personal matters out of the meeting.
toeic_zh: 請不要在會議中提出與個人事務無關的意見。

en: A small group within a larger group
toeic: One faction of the board opposed the merger.
toeic_zh: 董事會中的一個派系反對合併。

en: To delay or stop making progress
toeic: Negotiations stalled over the price of the contract.
toeic_zh: 談判因合約價格而陷入停滯。

en: Helpful and meant to improve things
simple_zh: 她給了有建設性的建議。
toeic: The manager offered constructive feedback after the presentation.
toeic_zh: 簡報後經理提出了有建設性的意見回饋。

en: A period of time between two events
toeic: Please check the machine at regular intervals.
toeic_zh: 請定期檢查機器。

en: a legal document about owning property; an action
simple: He signed the deed for the house.
toeic: The deed must be notarized before the property can be transferred.
toeic_zh: 契據必須經過公證，財產才能過戶。

en: coming soon; about to happen or appear
simple: Our forthcoming trip is in May.
simple_zh: 我們即將到來的旅行在五月。
toeic: Details of the forthcoming product launch will be announced next week.
toeic_zh: 即將推出的產品發表會細節將於下週公布。

en: how closely something is connected to a topic
simple: This idea has no relevance to us.
toeic: Please explain the relevance of this data to our sales strategy.
toeic_zh: 請說明這些數據與我們銷售策略的關聯性。

en: a formal agreement between people or groups
simple: The two friends made a pact.
simple_zh: 兩位朋友訂了一個約定。
toeic: The two companies signed a pact to share research costs.
toeic_zh: 兩家公司簽署協議以分攤研究成本。

en: a person or thing that acts for another
simple: She voted by proxy for her father.
toeic: Shareholders who cannot attend may vote by proxy at the meeting.
toeic_zh: 無法出席的股東可在會議中委託代理投票。

en: settling a dispute using an independent judge
simple: The two sides went to arbitration.
toeic: The dispute will be resolved through arbitration rather than in court.
toeic_zh: 這項爭議將透過仲裁而非法庭來解決。

en: possible and likely to work
toeic: The team studied whether building a second factory was feasible.
toeic_zh: 團隊研究了興建第二間工廠是否可行。

en: managing relations between countries, or tactful skill
simple: Good diplomacy can stop a fight.
simple_zh: 良好的外交可以避免爭吵。
toeic: The negotiator used diplomacy to settle the trade dispute.
toeic_zh: 談判代表運用外交手腕化解貿易爭端。

en: a starting level used for comparison
toeic: We measured current performance to set a baseline for future goals.
toeic_zh: 我們衡量目前績效，作為未來目標的基準。

en: a person or thing with a similar role elsewhere
simple: I called my counterpart in Japan.
simple_zh: 我打給日本的對口窗口。
toeic: Our sales director met her counterpart from the partner company.
toeic_zh: 我們的業務總監與合作公司的對等主管會面。

en: a group of voters or supporters in an area
toeic: The senator met with her constituency to hear their concerns.
toeic_zh: 參議員與選區民眾會面，聆聽他們的關切。

en: an official who represents a country abroad
toeic: The diplomat attended the trade summit on behalf of the government.
toeic_zh: 該外交官代表政府出席貿易高峰會。

en: to think something is smaller or less than it is
toeic: We tend to underestimate the time needed to finish the renovation.
toeic_zh: 我們低估了完成整修所需的時間。

en: causing great damage or failure
simple_zh: 那場暴風雨造成了災難。
toeic: The product launch was disastrous because of serious software errors.
toeic_zh: 由於嚴重的軟體錯誤，這次產品發表以慘敗收場。

en: in a way that both sides share
simple: We agreed on a mutually good time.
simple_zh: 我們同意了對雙方都好的時間。
toeic: The two parties reached a mutually acceptable solution.
toeic_zh: 雙方達成了彼此都能接受的解決方案。

en: about to happen very soon
toeic: The merger announcement is imminent, according to company sources.
toeic_zh: 據公司消息人士透露，併購公告即將發布。

en: a lack of something needed
toeic: The audit revealed a deficiency in the safety procedures.
toeic_zh: 稽核發現安全程序有缺失。

en: to arrange things in a line or agree
toeic: We must align our goals with the company strategy.
toeic_zh: 我們必須讓目標與公司策略一致。

en: a strong statement that something is true
toeic: The report supports the manager's assertion that sales are rising.
toeic_zh: 報告支持經理關於銷售正在成長的主張。

en: to state something firmly as true
simple: I assert that I am right.
toeic: The director asserted that the project would finish on time.
toeic_zh: 主任斷言專案會準時完成。

en: a person hurt or killed in an accident
simple: There was one casualty in the crash.
toeic: The factory fire caused no casualty, but the damage was heavy.
toeic_zh: 工廠火災沒有造成人員傷亡，但損失慘重。

en: based on an imagined situation, not fact
toeic: Let's consider a hypothetical case of rising material costs.
toeic_zh: 我們來設想一個原料成本上漲的假設情況。

en: to begin
simple: The class will commence at nine.
toeic: Construction will commence next month.
toeic_zh: 工程將於下個月開始。

en: a sudden event causing great damage
simple_zh: 那場洪水是一場大災難。
toeic: The insurance covers losses caused by a natural catastrophe.
toeic_zh: 這份保險涵蓋天然災難造成的損失。

en: to compete; to argue that something is true
simple: Two teams contend for the prize.
toeic: Small firms must contend with large global competitors.
toeic_zh: 小公司必須與大型跨國對手競爭。

en: a change to the opposite direction or decision
simple: The team had a sudden reversal.
toeic: The court ordered a reversal of the earlier decision.
toeic_zh: 法院下令撤銷先前的決定。

en: to win or be most common
toeic: Low prices still prevail in the local market.
toeic_zh: 本地市場仍普遍維持低價。

en: to protect something from harm
simple: Lock the door to safeguard your bike.
simple_zh: 鎖上門來保護你的腳踏車。
toeic: We use passwords to safeguard customer data.
toeic_zh: 我們用密碼來保護客戶資料。

en: the negative part of something
simple: The downside is the high price.
toeic: The main downside of the plan is its cost.
toeic_zh: 這項計畫的主要缺點是成本。

en: the reasons behind a decision
simple: What is the rationale for this rule?
simple_zh: 這項規定的理由是什麼？
toeic: The manager explained the rationale behind the price increase.
toeic_zh: 經理說明了調漲價格背後的理由。

en: to get a result or reward from effort
simple: Farmers reap the corn in fall.
toeic: The company will reap the benefits of its new strategy.
toeic_zh: 公司將從新策略中獲益。

en: a state of great confusion or trouble
toeic: The market was in turmoil after the announcement.
toeic_zh: 公告發布後市場陷入動盪。

en: a group of companies working together
simple_zh: 一個財團買下了這棟大樓。
toeic: A syndicate of banks provided the loan.
toeic_zh: 一個銀行團提供了這筆貸款。
